messages:
amira: Ran a focused short-query holdout for bobcat-13b (int8-per-channel+clamp0.9). Holdout = 100k queries <8 tokens, plus a 50k k=5 id-flip fuzz test. Quick summary: recall@1 delta -0.005 vs fp16, id-flip rate 0.32% (k=5). Details and command below.

sanjay: Good to see the deficit under 0.5. Paste the exact numbers and CI?

amira: Numbers (median of 3 seeds, semantic-suite v2 splits):

```
config               recall@1_short   recall@1_all   id_flip_k5
fp16                 0.842            0.872          0.10%
int8-per-channel     0.837            0.871          0.32%
delta                -0.005           -0.001         +0.22pp
```

95% CI on recall@1_short ~ +/-0.003. id-flip measured by sampling 50k queries and checking whether top-1 changed among original k=5 neighbors.

marco: That id-flip bump is small but notable. Which layers contributed most? Any layer-wise L2 drift?

amira: I exported layer-wise embeddings for 10k short queries and computed per-layer L2 drift between fp16 and int8. Layers 11 and 12 had the largest mean L2 drift (~0.015). I tried a targeted clamp on attn_out layers 11-12 and reran a 20k holdout:recall@1_short rose to 0.839 and id-flip dropped to 0.21%.

lina: Can you share the exact eval command and the sampling code? Ops wants to reproduce.

amira: Eval commands used: `rbw-eval --model bobcat-13b --weights ./runs/pc_clamp/weights.bin --eval semantic-suite-v2 --split short-only --samples 100000 --k 5 --out ./evals/4543210000/`

Id-flip script (snippet):
```
# sample 50k queries
for q in sample(queries, 50000):
  ref = knn_index.fp16.knn(q,k=5)
  test = knn_index.int8.knn(q,k=5)
  if ref[0] not in test:
    flips += 1
id_flip_rate = flips/50000
```

marco: Ops-bot, reservation to re-run targeted clamp sweep tomorrow? Prefer dedicated pool.

ops-bot: Reservation placed: dedicated-ml-2, 4xA100, 6h window tomorrow 18:00-00:00 UTC, job rbw-9002. Artifacts path /artifacts/rbw-9002/4543210000/.

sanjay: Next steps: 1) re-run full 100k short holdout with targeted clamp on layers 11-12 (3 seeds); 2) rerun id-flip fuzz test 3x at different random seeds (50k each); 3) if id-flip <0.25% and short recall delta <0.004, greenlight canary. Lina/Marco ok?

lina: OK. Add silhouette_k5 and a per-lang short-query check for multilingual tails.

marco: Add automated alert if id-flip >0.5% during canary.

amira: Will queue the job under rbw-9002 and post updated metrics here. TL;DR: short-query holdout shows small deficit but targeted clamp on attn_out 11-12 tightens gap and reduces id-flips. Re-run scheduled.
